T1.reason: The rounded body shell hides the main hardware, but the leg servos sit outside it as box-shaped pods, and dark brackets, horns and screw stubs show under the body and at the hips.

T2.reason: It uses off-white for the shell and dark grey for the mechanism, visor band and base ring, with one saturated orange accent placed only on the feet.

T3.reason: Only some hip axes get round disc caps, while the other joints show bare dark horns, brackets and stubs, so the joints read as unstyled hardware and are not treated the same way.

T4.reason: The body reads as one soft rounded box with generous radii and the legs are curved tubes, but the servo pods are boxy with small fillets and the parts do not merge.

T5.reason: A dark wrap-around band suggests a visor and gives the robot a front, but it is a plain stripe with no eye or focal detail, so the character is generic.

T6.reason: The orange ball feet are distinct, but the legs are thin tubes of uniform section splayed out from a wide, flat body, so the stance reads as sprawling rather than tapered.

T7.reason: It has a clean gradient backdrop, antialiased edges, a good three-quarter view and faint shadows at the feet, but the shell shading shows faceting artefacts and it lacks studio polish.
